name: JoAi: List Services

description.en: View team catalog services with names, prices and durations. Includes private services when the caller has team-member access; otherwise public-only.
description.de: Team-Dienstleistungen mit Namen, Preisen und Dauern anzeigen. Private Dienstleistungen werden einbezogen, wenn der Aufrufer Team-Mitgliedszugriff hat; sonst nur öffentliche.

bot: Use this when the user wants to see their available services, hourly rates, or billable services. Private services are included for team members; outsiders only see public ones.

inputs.name: includePrivate

description.en: Include private services when the caller has team-member access. Without team access the API still returns public-only.
description.de: Private Dienstleistungen einbeziehen, wenn der Aufrufer Team-Mitgliedszugriff hat. Ohne Team-Zugriff liefert die API weiterhin nur öffentliche.

inputs.bot: Defaults to true for team catalog listing. Private rows are only returned when the authenticated caller is a team member.

description.en: Filter by tags (e.g. hourly, consultation, maintenance, repair)
description.de: Nach Tags filtern (z.B. stundensatz, beratung, wartung, reparatur)

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
